ValidationRule.description: Checks whether Sap Customer Number is blank or not
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT( $Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c),NOT(CONTAINS( $Profile.Name , 'Digital Hub' )),NOT( PMC_SS_ClientDenied__c), ISPICKVAL( PMC_SS_IssueReason__c , 'MDM Verification'), AND(OR(ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Closed'),ISPICKVAL( Status , 'Closure Pending')), ISBLANK( PMC_SS_SAP_CustomerNumber__c )))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please fill the SAP Number before closing the Case
